description: A painted scene of Maya-style warriors climbing a stone staircase of a pyramid-temple. In the centre a figure with dark skin raises a tall standard topped with a carved feathered serpent head. Other warriors with round shields and spears surge up the steps on both sides, and a few figures are on the upper landing near a dark doorway. The stonework is weathered, with mist and trees behind. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text apart from a tiny mark in the bottom-right corner, and nothing gory is shown.
